# ABES Academic Calendar
Current session: 2026–27
Current public calendar: 2026–27 Odd Semester
Official calendar page: https://www.abes.ac.in/Academic-Calender.html

Date-specific answers must retrieve the latest official calendar rather than relying on this index file.

# ABES Programs
Current public course page lists:
B.Tech CSE — 900 seats
B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) — 360
B.Tech CSE (Data Science) — 180
B.Tech ECE — 180
B.Tech Electrical and Computer Engineering — 120
B.Tech Mechanical Engineering — 60
B.Tech CSE Working Professional — 30
B.Tech ECE Working Professional — 30
BCA — 120
MCA — 180
M.Tech CSE — 12
M.Tech ECE — 6

Public department areas include CSE, CSE-AIML, CSE-DS, ECE, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Sciences & Humanities, Information Technology and Computer Applications.

Source: https://www.abes.ac.in/courses-offered.html

# ABES Examination Knowledge
The official ABES circulars page publishes examination forms, examination schedules/guidelines, challenge evaluation, branch-change and other academic notices.

Official source: https://www.abes.ac.in/circulars.html

RAG rule:
For a date/deadline question, retrieve the latest applicable official circular. If two notices conflict, prefer the latest official notice applicable to the student's program/year. If applicability is uncertain, ask for program/year or route to the Examination Cell.
